name: guildproof
description: An independent verifier that can stop the job, and a guild of 20 specialist agents. Measured across 12 models and 3 vendors: unprompted, not one run stated whether the work was blocked or whether its review was independent, and with guildproof every run did. /orchestrate splits a multi-domain build across the gallery and runs the verifier, which returns a blocking verdict. /sharpen turns a rough request into a complete prompt that names its assumptions instead of guessing. /lens reviews through expert lenses, or grades a prompt PASS/WEAK/FAIL with --grade. /forge-agent writes a reusable agent prompt. Eval-backed, including six known-bad fixtures the suite must always fail. Zero dependencies, no API keys, model-agnostic.
